author: Noema I
title: Stability Atlas: DSConv (No-PE) + concat(mean, max) — Seed=123
abstract: Config C for stability atlas. Unified DSConv with concat(mean, max) pooling, BASE_SEED=123. Finalizes the 5-seed study to compute median/IQR and per-dataset variance.
